The spear/body/leg breakout in c02 and the sword/body/impact breakout in c05 visibly cross the drawn oblique inner borders while retaining clean white outer margin. This matches the source and plan instruction to display the full unmasked breakout asset; no accidental CSS polygon clipping or source-border truncation was visible.

No disconnected shaft or obscured required face/hand is visible.
